metadata.description: 5-inch FPV quadcopter reference model (in development: perfect sensors). NED world / FRD body axes, quaternion 6-DOF rigid body, four first-order motor/propeller subsystems, and a Betaflight-style acro flight controller at 1 kHz (rates, gyro PT1 filters, rate PID with feed-forward, quad-X mixer with airmode) re-implemented from documented behaviour and defaults. The Pilot subsystem scripts a roll doublet, a pitch doublet and a yaw step at hover throttle. Parameters from the kingfisher model in uzh-rpg/agile_flight (MIT) and Kaufmann et al. 2022; equation structure after uzh-rpg/flightmare (MIT). See docs/fpv-reference-model-plan.md.
